# Test 20261112-062518-56d9: evaluation

| Class | Turn | Evidence | Issue |
|---|---|---|---|
| business_rule | 2 | trace.jsonl:15, trace.jsonl:17, trace.jsonl:18; RULES.md:5; services.py:44 | The customer requested `qty: 1` for order `6210`, but the app sent two successful `POST /reserve` requests, creating `RS-621463` and `RS-746566`, each for one item. Stock fell from 3 to 1. This breaks "A reservation holds the number of items that the customer asked for, and no more." The service client loops twice even after success. |
| missing_action | 2 | turn 2; trace.jsonl:15; APP_SPEC.md:21 | The reservation turn calls only `shop.reserve`, with no stock check. The reservation goal requires "The agent checks the stock, reserves the number of items that the customer asked for". The stock check in turn 1 does not fulfill the check required for this reservation turn. |
| state_mismatch | 2 | trace.jsonl:17, trace.jsonl:18, trace.jsonl:20; stock.json | The reply says "I've reserved 1 teapot set for order 6210 under reservation RS-746566." The stock service actually holds two one-item reservations for this order, also confirmed by current `stock.json`. The reply omits the extra item held. |
| unsupported_reply | 3 | trace.jsonl:28, trace.jsonl:30, trace.jsonl:32; trace.jsonl:17, trace.jsonl:18 | The reply attributes the decrease to "your reservation and that of another customer." The stock result supports only `left: 1`; no result supports another customer's reservation. Both recorded reservations are for order `6210`. |

## Notes

The seal is intact. The audit reports three matching exchanges, no breaks, and no errors. Automated findings are empty, but the backend records prove the duplicate reservation.

Checked all three transcript turns and their model items, findings.json, audit.json, manifest.json, APP_SPEC.md, RULES.md, app.py, services.py, stock.py and entry.py. Read current stock.json and state.json without starting or messaging the app. Current stock.json agrees with both recorded reservation responses. No app-state files were available under the test folder, so current project state is corroborating evidence rather than a sealed state snapshot.

All turns meet APP_SPEC.md's limits of 30 seconds and 2000 model-session output tokens. Turns 1, 2 and 3 took 4.204, 3.379 and 3.187 seconds and used 137, 147 and 105 model-session output tokens respectively. Some direct model API usage is unknown, but those tokens are excluded from the specified token limit. Replies meet the two-sentence persona limit. No tested request required a refusal.

Only this report was written; app state and code were not changed.

## Tester notes

The tester wrote no note.

## Coverage

A proxy saw each egress part.
